description: Publish a post to the user's PUBLIC BudgetPixel community feed — visible to everyone and labeled "via MCP". ONLY use this when the user EXPLICITLY asks to post/share/publish; never post proactively. Costs 10 credits per post (anti-spam, charged on publish — same as the developer API) with an hourly posting cap. media: 1–6 images, or 1 video + up to 3 images, or exactly 1 audio track — pass the URLs you got from generations (check_generation_status links) or upload_media, or any public URL/base64. Images can carry optional model/prompt generation info. Audio posts accept song_name, genre (a fixed list — see the enum), lyrics, AND cover_image (cover art goes in its own field, never as a second media item). To enter the post in one of the user's clan themes, pass theme_id (call list_my_themes to find it). Returns the public post URL — share it with the user. Posts are moderated after publish (NSFW/spam rating affects feed visibility; the charge is not refunded for hidden posts).

content.description: The post's text/caption (optional — media-only posts are fine).

cover_image.description: Audio posts only: cover art — an image URL (generation link / upload_media URL), data URI, or base64 (max 15MB). Goes in THIS field, never as a media item.

genre.description: Audio posts only: the track's genre — EXACTLY one of these values. Omit to have it classified automatically after publishing.

lyrics.description: Audio posts only: lyrics to show with the track.

media.description: 1–6 media items. Rules: 1–6 images, OR 1 video plus up to 3 images, OR exactly 1 audio track (audio can't mix).

file.description: The media file — a URL (generation result link, upload_media URL, or any public URL), a data URI, or raw base64.

model.description: Optional generation info: the model that made this image (images only).

prompt.description: Optional generation info: the prompt that made this image (images only).

song_name.description: Audio posts only: the track's display name.

theme_id.description: Optional: enter the post in a live clan theme — the id from list_my_themes (or the number in a budgetpixel.com/themes/<id> link). Works with any media type; posting to a theme of a clan the user hasn't joined joins them to it, like on the site.
